items.text: REFERRED TO COMMERCE, ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND SMALL BUSINESS

items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the alcoholic beverage control law, in relation to the issuance of a retail license for on-premises consumption for certain premises
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S6825

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the alcoholic beverage control law,
in relation to the issuance of a retail license for on-premises
consumption for certain premises

 PURPOSE :

This bill will permit the authority to issue a retail license for
on-premises consumption in an establishment that is within two hundred
feet of a place of worship and situated on Elmwood Avenue.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :

Subdivision 7 of section 64 of the alcoholic beverage control law is
amended by adding a new paragraph (e-8) which permits for on-premises
conception for a premise, located in the bill by metes and bounds, and
is within two hundred feet of a place of worship.

 JUSTIFICATION :

A restaurant on Elmwood Avenue (Pano's) is within 200 ft of a place of
worship. The synagogue is spearheading the effort to help the
restaurant obtain a liquor license. They have sent letters in support
to the SLA encouraging them to exempt Pano's from the 200 ft rule.
SLA does not have this authority and this bill is necessary to allow
the license to proceed. On the same block as Pano's is a liquor store
and two additional bars that have a full liquor license. The synagogue
has stated that they are not harmed by the licenses and would actually
encourage the further issuance of such licenses to responsible
business owners. They see this as not only being "neighborly" but
helping to boost businesses within the community of which they are a
part.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

None.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately.
